geometry_cache.contents: uint8 label map, clipped polygon rings (pixel coords), per-instance scalars

instance_identity.source_feature_id: 1-based EA.shp record order within this exact archive
instance_identity.tile_instance_id: deterministic 1-based order of clipped features in one tile

shapefile_provenance.identity_note: source_feature_id is the 1-based .shp record order within this exact archive; the DBF attribute table is degenerate (Task 6K.1) and is never used for identity
shapefile_provenance.shp_path_logical: 2. The shape file of the whole images/EA.shp

source_root_note: the external WHU archive root is supplied at runtime (--source-root); committed metadata stores only logical paths relative to that root, never absolute paths
tile_id_definition: tile_id is the archive's own tile name (e.g. `1_0`, `0`), unique across the cropped archive; grid_id = `<raster>:<row>:<col>` is the whole-raster coordinate identity
